## Specification

### Component: Carousel

A native scroll-snap track with previous/next buttons, dots and keyboard arrows. Swiping and trackpad scrolling are the browser's; the component reads and nudges the scroll position.

#### Anatomy
```
<Carousel>                 <div role="region" aria-roledescription="carousel" class="ui-carousel" data-orientation>
  <CarouselContent>        <div class="ui-carousel-viewport" tabindex="0">   (overflow auto, scroll-snap-type x mandatory)
                             <div class="ui-carousel-content">               (flex track, position: relative)
    <CarouselItem />         <div role="group" aria-roledescription="slide" aria-label="n of m" class="ui-carousel-item">
  <CarouselPrevious />     <button class="ui-btn ui-btn-outline ui-btn-sm ui-btn-icon ui-carousel-nav ui-carousel-prev" aria-label="Previous slide">
  <CarouselNext />         … ui-carousel-next, aria-label="Next slide"
  <CarouselDots />         <div role="group" aria-label="Choose a slide" class="ui-carousel-dots"> <button class="ui-carousel-dot" aria-label="Go to slide n" aria-current="true">
```

#### Props
- `Carousel`: `orientation` (`horizontal` default | `vertical`), `loop` (default false), `autoplay` (`boolean | number` ms; `true` = 5000), `onIndexChange(index)`, `aria-label`.
- `CarouselItem`: `basis` (CSS length) — or size with `className`.
- CSS knobs on the root: `--ui-carousel-gap` (1rem), `--ui-carousel-per-view` (1; set responsively with `sm:[--ui-carousel-per-view:2]`). Item `flex-basis = (100% - (per-view - 1) * gap) / per-view`.

#### Behaviour
- Slides are direct children of the content track, `scroll-snap-align: start`, `scroll-snap-stop: always`.
- Stopping points: only slides that can be scrolled to the start position count (so with 2 per view and 5 slides there are 4 dots). One stop (everything fits): dots render nothing.
- Active position is derived from scroll position and refreshed by an `IntersectionObserver` on the slides (thresholds 0, .25, .5, .75, 1) plus resize, `scroll` (rAF) and `scrollend`. At the start it is 0, at the end the last stop, else the stop nearest the scroll position.
- Previous / Next scroll to the neighbouring stop (smooth; instant under reduced motion). At an end without `loop` the button is `aria-disabled="true"` (still focusable) and does nothing. With `loop` they never disable and wrap (a rewind).
- Dots scroll to their stop; the active dot has `aria-current="true"`.
- Keyboard: ArrowLeft/Right (ArrowUp/Down when vertical) anywhere inside the carousel (not in inputs, textareas, selects, contenteditable) moves one stop and prevents the default scroll.
- Autoplay: every interval, advance one stop (rewinding at the end). Skipped while the pointer is over the carousel, focus is inside it, the document is hidden, or reduced motion is on.
- Slides get `aria-label="n of m"` set after mount and when children change, unless the author passes `aria-label`.

#### Visual rules
- Viewport radius `--radius-lg`, scrollbar hidden, focus ring on `:focus-visible`.
- Nav buttons: 32px round outline buttons floating over the track edges (left/right .75rem, vertically centred; nudged up by 1.25rem when dots exist), `--ui-shadow-md` (floating layer), no shadow when disabled. Vertical carousels place them top/bottom centred.
- Dots: 24px hit area, 8px dot in `--ui-border-strong`; active is a 20px pill in `--ui-primary`. Vertical: dots stack on the right.

#### Motion
- Active dot width transitions on `--ui-spring-snappy`; colours on `--ui-duration-fast`.
- Scrolling is the browser's smooth scroll. Reduced motion: instant jumps, autoplay off.

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA carousel pattern: region + `aria-roledescription="carousel"`, slides `role="group"` + `aria-roledescription="slide"` + "n of m".
- The track is focusable (`tabindex=0`) so keyboard users can always scroll it.
- Dots are real buttons with names; buttons keep focus at the ends (`aria-disabled`).

#### Acceptance checks
- N slides produce N labels "1 of N" … "N of N".
- Clicking Next scrolls the track and moves `aria-current` to the next dot; Previous is `aria-disabled` at the start and Next at the end.
- Arrow keys move the carousel; dots navigate directly.
- `loop`: Next on the last stop returns to the first.
- No serious axe violations in light and dark.

Paths are relative to the folder the `@/` alias points to. The folder keeps the library's own layout, so the relative imports inside the files work unchanged. Files of the components it uses are in their own docs (see Instructions).

### `ui/components/carousel/carousel-controls.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, type HTMLAttributes, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Button, type ButtonProps } from '../button/button';
import { useCarouselContext } from './carousel';

export interface CarouselButtonProps extends Omit<ButtonProps, 'icon' | 'asChild' | 'loading'> {}

/**
 * Previous slide. Place it inside `Carousel`, beside `CarouselContent`. It stays focusable at the start
 * but is marked `aria-disabled` and does nothing (it is never disabled with `loop`).
 */
export const CarouselPrevious = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, CarouselButtonProps>(function CarouselPrevious(
  { className, variant = 'outline', size = 'sm', onClick, children, 'aria-label': label = 'Previous slide', ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const { canPrev, scrollPrev, orientation } = useCarouselContext('CarouselPrevious');
  return (
    <Button
      ref={ref}
      icon
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn('ui-carousel-nav ui-carousel-prev', className)}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-disabled={!canPrev || undefined}
      data-orientation={orientation}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented && canPrev) scrollPrev();
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {children ?? <Icon name={orientation === 'vertical' ? 'chevron-up' : 'chevron-left'} />}
    </Button>
  );
});

/** Next slide. See `CarouselPrevious`. */
export const CarouselNext = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, CarouselButtonProps>(function CarouselNext(
  { className, variant = 'outline', size = 'sm', onClick, children, 'aria-label': label = 'Next slide', ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const { canNext, scrollNext, orientation } = useCarouselContext('CarouselNext');
  return (
    <Button
      ref={ref}
      icon
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={cn('ui-carousel-nav ui-carousel-next', className)}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-disabled={!canNext || undefined}
      data-orientation={orientation}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented && canNext) scrollNext();
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {children ?? <Icon name={orientation === 'vertical' ? 'chevron-down' : 'chevron-right'} />}
    </Button>
  );
});

/**
 * One dot per stopping position, the active one marked `aria-current="true"` and stretched.
 * Renders nothing when everything fits (a single position).
 */
export const CarouselDots = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function CarouselDots(
  { className, role = 'group', 'aria-label': label = 'Choose a slide', ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const { index, snaps, scrollTo, orientation } = useCarouselContext('CarouselDots');
  if (snaps <= 1) return null;
  return (
    <div ref={ref} role={role} aria-label={label} className={cn('ui-carousel-dots', className)} data-orientation={orientation} {...props}>
      {Array.from({ length: snaps }, (_, i) => (
        <button
          key={i}
          type="button"
          className="ui-carousel-dot"
          aria-label={`Go to slide ${i + 1}`}
          aria-current={i === index ? 'true' : undefined}
          data-state={i === index ? 'active' : 'inactive'}
          onClick={() => scrollTo(i)}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/carousel/carousel.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { createContext, forwardRef, useContext, useMemo, type CSSProperties, type HTMLAttributes, type KeyboardEvent, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useCarousel, type CarouselOrientation, type CarouselState } from './use-carousel';

export interface CarouselContextValue extends CarouselState {
  orientation: CarouselOrientation;
  loop: boolean;
  scrollTo: (index: number) => void;
  scrollPrev: () => void;
  scrollNext: () => void;
  viewportRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  contentRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
}

const CarouselContext = createContext<CarouselContextValue | null>(null);

export function useCarouselContext(part: string): CarouselContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(CarouselContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${part}> must be used inside <Carousel>`);
  return ctx;
}

export interface CarouselProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Scroll direction. A vertical carousel needs a height. Default `horizontal`. */
  orientation?: CarouselOrientation;
  /** Wrap around: Next on the last position goes back to the first (a rewind, not an endless strip). Default `false`. */
  loop?: boolean;
  /**
   * Advance on a timer: `true` (every 5 s) or an interval in milliseconds. Pauses while the pointer is over
   * it, focus is inside it or the tab is hidden, and never runs under reduced motion. At the end it rewinds.
   */
  autoplay?: boolean | number;
  /** Called with the first visible position whenever it changes (swipes, keys, buttons, dots, autoplay). */
  onIndexChange?: (index: number) => void;
  /** Accessible name of the carousel, e.g. "Product photos". Strongly recommended. */
  'aria-label'?: string;
}

/**
 * Carousel — a scroll-snap track with previous/next buttons, dots and keyboard arrows. Swiping and
 * trackpad scrolling are the browser's own. Compose: CarouselContent > CarouselItem…, CarouselPrevious,
 * CarouselNext, CarouselDots. Show several slides at once by setting `--ui-carousel-per-view` (and
 * `--ui-carousel-gap`) on the root, e.g. `className="[--ui-carousel-per-view:2]"`.
 */
export const Carousel = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CarouselProps>(function Carousel(
  { orientation = 'horizontal', loop = false, autoplay = false, onIndexChange, className, onKeyDown, onMouseEnter, onMouseLeave, onFocus, onBlur, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const c = useCarousel({ orientation, loop, autoplay, onIndexChange });
  const value = useMemo<CarouselContextValue>(
    () => ({
      ...c.state,
      orientation,
      loop,
      scrollTo: c.scrollTo,
      scrollPrev: c.scrollPrev,
      scrollNext: c.scrollNext,
      viewportRef: c.viewportRef,
      contentRef: c.contentRef,
    }),
    [c.state, orientation, loop, c.scrollTo, c.scrollPrev, c.scrollNext, c.viewportRef, c.contentRef],
  );

  return (
    <CarouselContext.Provider value={value}>
        <div
          ref={ref}
          role="region"
          aria-roledescription="carousel"
          className={cn('ui-carousel', className)}
          data-orientation={orientation}
          data-autoplay={c.autoplaying || undefined}
          onKeyDown={(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
            onKeyDown?.(e);
            c.onKeyDown(e);
          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => {
            onMouseEnter?.(e);
            c.pauseProps.onMouseEnter();
          }}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => {
            onMouseLeave?.(e);
            c.pauseProps.onMouseLeave();
          }}
          onFocus={(e) => {
            onFocus?.(e);
            c.pauseProps.onFocus();
          }}
          onBlur={(e) => {
            onBlur?.(e);
            c.pauseProps.onBlur(e);
          }}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
    </CarouselContext.Provider>
  );
});

export interface CarouselContentProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Class for the scrolling viewport; `className` styles the inner track that holds the slides. */
  viewportClassName?: string;
}

/** The scrolling track. Its direct children must be `CarouselItem`s. */
export const CarouselContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CarouselContentProps>(function CarouselContent(
  { className, viewportClassName, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useCarouselContext('CarouselContent');
  const setContent = useComposedRefs(ref, ctx.contentRef);
  return (
    <div
      ref={ctx.viewportRef}
      className={cn('ui-carousel-viewport', viewportClassName)}
      // Scrollable regions must be reachable by keyboard (arrows are handled by the carousel)
      tabIndex={0}
    >
      <div ref={setContent} className={cn('ui-carousel-content', className)} data-orientation={ctx.orientation} {...props} />
    </div>
  );
});

export interface CarouselItemProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Width (height when vertical) as a CSS length, e.g. `"80%"` or `"16rem"`. Default: one slide per view. */
  basis?: string;
}

/** One slide. Labelled "n of m" automatically; pass `aria-label` to name it yourself. */
export const CarouselItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CarouselItemProps>(function CarouselItem(
  { basis, className, style, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="group"
      aria-roledescription="slide"
      className={cn('ui-carousel-item', className)}
      data-custom-label={props['aria-label'] ? '' : undefined}
      style={basis ? ({ ...style, '--ui-carousel-basis': basis } as CSSProperties) : style}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/carousel/use-carousel.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type FocusEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../../lib/dom';

export type CarouselOrientation = 'horizontal' | 'vertical';

export interface CarouselState {
  /** Index of the first snap position in view (0-based). */
  index: number;
  /** Number of positions the track can rest on (slides minus those that fit at the end). */
  snaps: number;
  canPrev: boolean;
  canNext: boolean;
}

export interface UseCarouselOptions {
  orientation: CarouselOrientation;
  loop: boolean;
  /** `true` or an interval in ms (default 5000). */
  autoplay: boolean | number;
  onIndexChange?: (index: number) => void;
}

const ITEM = '.ui-carousel-item';
const DEFAULT_INTERVAL = 5000;

/**
 * State and behaviour of a Carousel. The track is a native scroll-snap container; this hook only reads it
 * (position, which slide is in view) and nudges it (previous, next, go to). Active slide is kept in sync
 * with an IntersectionObserver on the slides, so touch swipes, trackpads and keys all update the dots.
 */
export function useCarousel({ orientation, loop, autoplay, onIndexChange }: UseCarouselOptions) {
  const viewportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const vertical = orientation === 'vertical';
  const [state, setState] = useState<CarouselState>({ index: 0, snaps: 0, canPrev: false, canNext: true });
  const stateRef = useRef(state);
  stateRef.current = state;
  const onIndexChangeRef = useRef(onIndexChange);
  onIndexChangeRef.current = onIndexChange;
  const paused = useRef({ hover: false, focus: false });

  const getItems = useCallback(
    () => (contentRef.current ? (Array.from(contentRef.current.children).filter((el) => el.matches(ITEM)) as HTMLElement[]) : []),
    [],
  );

  /** Recompute which snap position is showing, how many there are and whether either end is reachable. */
  const measure = useCallback(() => {
    const vp = viewportRef.current;
    if (!vp) return;
    const items = getItems();
    const pos = vertical ? vp.scrollTop : vp.scrollLeft;
    const size = vertical ? vp.clientHeight : vp.clientWidth;
    const total = vertical ? vp.scrollHeight : vp.scrollWidth;
    const max = Math.max(0, total - size);
    const offsets = items.map((el) => (vertical ? el.offsetTop : el.offsetLeft));
    // A slide is a stopping point only if the track can scroll far enough to put it at the start
    const stops = offsets.filter((o) => o <= max + 1);
    const snaps = max <= 1 ? Math.min(1, items.length) : Math.max(1, stops.length);
    let index = 0;
    if (pos > 1) {
      if (pos >= max - 1) index = snaps - 1;
      else {
        let best = Infinity;
        stops.forEach((o, i) => {
          const d = Math.abs(o - pos);
          if (d < best) {
            best = d;
            index = i;
          }
        });
      }
    }
    const next: CarouselState = { index, snaps, canPrev: loop ? snaps > 1 : pos > 1, canNext: loop ? snaps > 1 : pos < max - 1 };
    setState((prev) =>
      prev.index === next.index && prev.snaps === next.snaps && prev.canPrev === next.canPrev && prev.canNext === next.canNext ? prev : next,
    );
  }, [getItems, vertical, loop]);

  const scrollTo = useCallback(
    (i: number) => {
      const vp = viewportRef.current;
      const items = getItems();
      if (!vp || !items.length) return;
      const target = items[Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, i))]!;
      const behavior: ScrollBehavior = prefersReducedMotion() ? 'auto' : 'smooth';
      vp.scrollTo(vertical ? { top: target.offsetTop, behavior } : { left: target.offsetLeft, behavior });
    },
    [getItems, vertical],
  );

  const scrollNext = useCallback(() => {
    const { index, snaps } = stateRef.current;
    if (index < snaps - 1) scrollTo(index + 1);
    else if (loop) scrollTo(0);
  }, [scrollTo, loop]);

  const scrollPrev = useCallback(() => {
    const { index, snaps } = stateRef.current;
    if (index > 0) scrollTo(index - 1);
    else if (loop) scrollTo(snaps - 1);
  }, [scrollTo, loop]);

  // Observe slides, label them "n of m", and re-measure when slides come and go or the size changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const vp = viewportRef.current;
    const content = contentRef.current;
    if (!vp || !content) return;
    let io: IntersectionObserver | undefined;
    const refresh = () => {
      const items = getItems();
      items.forEach((el, i) => {
        if (!el.hasAttribute('data-custom-label')) el.setAttribute('aria-label', `${i + 1} of ${items.length}`);
      });
      io?.disconnect();
      if (typeof IntersectionObserver !== 'undefined') {
        io = new IntersectionObserver(measure, { root: vp, threshold: [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] });
        items.forEach((el) => io!.observe(el));
      }
      measure();
    };
    refresh();
    const mo = typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined' ? new MutationObserver(refresh) : undefined;
    mo?.observe(content, { childList: true });
    const ro = typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined' ? new ResizeObserver(measure) : undefined;
    ro?.observe(vp);
    ro?.observe(content);
    let raf = 0;
    const onScroll = () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(measure);
    };
    vp.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    vp.addEventListener('scrollend', measure);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      vp.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
      vp.removeEventListener('scrollend', measure);
      io?.disconnect();
      mo?.disconnect();
      ro?.disconnect();
    };
  }, [getItems, measure]);

  const firstRender = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (firstRender.current) {
      firstRender.current = false;
      return;
    }
    onIndexChangeRef.current?.(state.index);
  }, [state.index]);

  // Autoplay: tick on an interval; skip while hovered, focused, in a hidden tab or under reduced motion
  const interval = autoplay === true ? DEFAULT_INTERVAL : autoplay || 0;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!interval) return;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      if (paused.current.hover || paused.current.focus || document.hidden || prefersReducedMotion()) return;
      const { index, snaps } = stateRef.current;
      if (snaps <= 1) return;
      scrollTo(index < snaps - 1 ? index + 1 : 0);
    }, interval);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [interval, scrollTo]);

  const onKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      if (e.defaultPrevented || e.altKey || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) return;
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
      if (target.closest('input, textarea, select, [contenteditable="true"]')) return;
      const prevKey = vertical ? 'ArrowUp' : 'ArrowLeft';
      const nextKey = vertical ? 'ArrowDown' : 'ArrowRight';
      if (e.key === prevKey) {
        e.preventDefault();
        scrollPrev();
      } else if (e.key === nextKey) {
        e.preventDefault();
        scrollNext();
      }
    },
    [vertical, scrollPrev, scrollNext],
  );

  const pauseProps = useMemo(
    () => ({
      onMouseEnter: () => {
        paused.current.hover = true;
      },
      onMouseLeave: () => {
        paused.current.hover = false;
      },
      onFocus: () => {
        paused.current.focus = true;
      },
      onBlur: (e: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
        if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) paused.current.focus = false;
      },
    }),
    [],
  );

  return { viewportRef, contentRef, state, scrollTo, scrollNext, scrollPrev, onKeyDown, pauseProps, autoplaying: interval > 0 };
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/carousel.css`

```css
/* Carousel ----------------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-carousel[data-orientation="horizontal|vertical"]
     > .ui-carousel-viewport (native scroll-snap, tabindex=0)
         > .ui-carousel-content (flex track) > .ui-carousel-item (role=group slide)
     > .ui-carousel-nav (.ui-carousel-prev | .ui-carousel-next)   floating round buttons
     > .ui-carousel-dots > .ui-carousel-dot[data-state="active|inactive"]
   Knobs (set on the root): --ui-carousel-gap (1rem), --ui-carousel-per-view (1).
   Swipe, trackpad and wheel are the browser's; snapping is CSS.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-carousel {
    --ui-carousel-gap: 1rem;
    --ui-carousel-per-view: 1;
    position: relative;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .ui-carousel-viewport {
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
  .ui-carousel-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .ui-carousel-viewport:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-carousel[data-orientation="vertical"] > .ui-carousel-viewport {
    height: 100%;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    overflow-y: auto;
    scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
    overscroll-behavior-x: auto;
    overscroll-behavior-y: contain;
  }

  .ui-carousel-content {
    position: relative; /* slides measure their offset from here */
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--ui-carousel-gap);
  }
  .ui-carousel-content[data-orientation="vertical"] { flex-direction: column; height: 100%; }

  .ui-carousel-item {
    flex: 0 0 var(--ui-carousel-basis, calc((100% - (var(--ui-carousel-per-view) - 1) * var(--ui-carousel-gap)) / var(--ui-carousel-per-view)));
    min-width: 0;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    scroll-snap-stop: always;
  }
  .ui-carousel-content[data-orientation="vertical"] > .ui-carousel-item { min-height: 0; }

  /* Prev / next: round buttons floating over the track edges (a floating layer, so they may cast a shadow) */
  .ui-carousel-nav {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    top: calc(50% - 1rem);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-md);
  }
  .ui-carousel:has(.ui-carousel-dots) > .ui-carousel-nav { top: calc(50% - 1rem - 1.25rem); }
  .ui-carousel-prev { left: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-carousel-next { right: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-carousel-nav[data-orientation="vertical"] { right: auto; left: calc(50% - 1rem); }
  .ui-carousel-nav.ui-carousel-prev[data-orientation="vertical"] { top: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-carousel-nav.ui-carousel-next[data-orientation="vertical"] { top: auto; bottom: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-carousel-nav[aria-disabled="true"] { box-shadow: none; }

  /* Dots: 24px hit areas around 8px dots; the active one stretches into a pill */
  .ui-carousel-dots {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
  }
  .ui-carousel-dot {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 1.5rem;
    height: 1.5rem;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .ui-carousel-dot::before {
    content: "";
    width: 0.5rem;
    height: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-border-strong);
    transition:
      width var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy),
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-carousel-dot[aria-current="true"]::before { width: 1.25rem; background-color: var(--ui-primary); }
  .ui-carousel-dot:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-carousel-dot:not([aria-current="true"]):hover::before { background-color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  }
  .ui-carousel-dots[data-orientation="vertical"] { position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 0.5rem; flex-direction: column; margin: 0; transform: translateY(-50%); }
  .ui-carousel-dots[data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-carousel-dot::before { transition-property: height, background-color; }
  .ui-carousel-dots[data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-carousel-dot[aria-current="true"]::before { width: 0.5rem; height: 1.25rem; }
}
```

## Usage

**Product images** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/carousel/product-images.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselDots, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious } from '@/ui/components/carousel';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

const photos = [
  { label: 'Front view', series: 1 },
  { label: 'Side profile', series: 2 },
  { label: 'Sole detail', series: 3 },
  { label: 'On foot', series: 4 },
  { label: 'Box and extras', series: 5 },
];

export default function CarouselProductImages() {
  return (
    <Carousel className="w-full max-w-md" aria-label="Trail runner photos">
      <CarouselContent>
        {photos.map((photo) => (
          <CarouselItem key={photo.label}>
            <div
              className="flex aspect-[4/3] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border text-muted-foreground"
              style={{ background: `color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-series-${photo.series}) 16%, var(--ui-surface))` }}
            >
              <Icon name="image" size={32} />
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{photo.label}</span>
            </div>
          </CarouselItem>
        ))}
      </CarouselContent>
      <CarouselPrevious />
      <CarouselNext />
      <CarouselDots />
    </Carousel>
  );
}
```
